categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Wave Cyber Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of membrane materials and related professional supporting equipment. Its main products include reverse osmosis membranes, nanofiltration membranes, membrane element pressure vessels, and composite material pressure tanks. The company also provides water treatment equipment and services, including operation and maintenance and engineering project services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies such as integrated casting and coating production lines, precise coating techniques for support layers and desalination layers, membrane cleaning mechanisms, polymer modification technologies, and advanced structural design for composite pressure vessels. It has developed high-performance polyamide reverse osmosis and nanofiltration membrane formulations, high-flux household membranes, acid and alkali resistant membranes, and membranes for seawater desalination. Production involves advanced polymer coating, fiber winding, and curing processes, supported by ISO9001 quality management and certifications from NSF, ASME, and KTW.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial enterprises in sectors such as municipal water supply, wastewater treatment, seawater desalination, power, metallurgy, chemical, and food and beverage industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales to customers in Europe, America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Its products are used in water purification, industrial water reuse, lithium extraction from salt lakes and lithium batteries recycling, and zero-discharge industrial systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai and Huzhou, Zhejiang Province. It also has subsidiaries in the United States and Qinghai Province. Its sales and services cover domestic markets extensively and international markets including Europe, America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Overseas assets account for a small portion of total assets, with the US subsidiary using USD as its functional currency.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Wave Cyber operates mainly in the midstream segment of the membrane separation industry, focusing on the manufacturing of high-performance membrane materials and related pressure vessels. It controls the full production chain from membrane material formulation, membrane element assembly, to composite pressure tank manufacturing, positioning itself as a core component supplier in the membrane separation supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, investing heavily in R&D to enhance membrane performance and develop new applications such as lithium extraction from salt lakes, lithium battery recycling, seawater desalination, and industrial zero-discharge membranes. It pursues advanced polymer modification, coating technologies, and membrane element design software upgrades. The company aims to promote domestic substitution of imported high-end membranes and expand into diversified, high value-added membrane product lines.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of membrane materials, membrane elements, composite pressure tanks, and water treatment equipment. The company also earns income from providing operation and maintenance services, engineering project services, and design services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales (over 70%) complemented by distributor channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international membrane manufacturers such as DuPont Water Solutions (Dow), Koch, Toray, Hydranautics, and SUEZ (GE), as well as domestic competitors like Waton Technology. While it faces challenges in scale, brand recognition, and experience compared to global leaders, it leverages proprietary technologies and diversified product offerings to strengthen its market position and expand into niche segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 375.2 million, a slight decrease of 2.34% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.59 million, down 16%. Total assets reached RMB 911.46 million with net assets of RMB 772.11 million. The company maintains steady R&D investment at about 7.77% of revenue and has shown stable cash flow from operations with a positive growth trend.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Wave Cyber emphasizes its independent intellectual property rights, advanced membrane technology, and comprehensive product portfolio covering membranes, membrane elements, and composite pressure vessels. Its products meet international certifications (NSF, ASME, KTW) and deliver superior performance in flux, salt rejection, and durability. The company offers flexible customization, high value-added membrane solutions for emerging applications like lithium extraction and battery recycling, and contributes to sustainable water treatment and environmental protection.
